# Biztreck Solutions

> Biztreck Solutions builds, revamps, ranks and scales digital products —
> high-performance websites and apps, DevOps, technical SEO, and zero-to-one
> startup launches. Based in Greater Noida, Delhi NCR, India.

## About
- Site: https://biztreck.com
- Contact: connect@biztreck.com
- Services: Website development, website revamp, app development, DevOps,
  SEO, MVP / startup launch.

## Key pages
- Home: https://biztreck.com/
- About: https://biztreck.com/about
- Blog: https://biztreck.com/blog
- Careers: https://biztreck.com/careers

## Machine-readable interfaces
- API catalog: https://biztreck.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent skills index: https://biztreck.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Blog list (JSON): https://biztreck.com/api/blogs
- Open roles (JSON): https://biztreck.com/api/jobs
- Contact (POST JSON): https://biztreck.com/api/contact
- Health: https://biztreck.com/api/health

## Content negotiation
Any page also serves Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`,
e.g. `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://biztreck.com/blog/<slug>`.

## Content usage preferences
Declared in https://biztreck.com/robots.txt via Content-Signal:
search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no.
